svg.title: 4K Omarchy frame achieved; Real guest GPU reaches QEMU SDL; active repeats pass; backend 4 of 8 stages; desktop product 0 of 4 gates
svg.desc: Real NVIDIA Omarchy wallpaper, bar and application reach QEMU SDL. Four active 300-frame guest runs pass complete source/window pixel and live-cleanup audits. A setup failure and all-zero SDL capture remain rejected. Earlier device loss remains unresolved. No performance gain is established. The 4K source is scaled to a 2560 by 1566 SDL backbuffer. Backend stages stay 4 of 8 and product gates stay 0 of 4. Updated October 21, 2026.

g.text: First Hyprland frame achieved · Complete GPU backbuffer: 3840×2160
Real guest → QEMU SDL: four active 300-frame runs pass complete pixel audits
Failures retained: device loss + zero SDL capture; no performance gain established
Next: audit window state, diagnose frame pacing and retain official input
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-21
Real guest GPU source: 3840×2160 · SDL backbuffer: 2560×1566 · Physical 4K scanout unverified
Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort or product readiness.
